## Summary
Describe the potential risk at a high level.

## Impact
Who or what could be affected?

## Reproduction notes
Share only safe, non-sensitive steps. Do not include real tokens, passwords, private keys, or production `.env` values.

## Suggested mitigation
If known, describe a safe fix or containment step.

## Private details
If sensitive details are required, coordinate privately with a maintainer instead of posting secrets in this public issue.
